lines.zh: 我四爪落在村道上，焦油一路滴。
lines.en: My four claws hit the road, dripping tar all the way.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张着，走路时扫过屋顶。
lines.en: My wings stay half-open and sweep the rooftops.

lines.zh: 焦油从我的鳞缝里慢慢渗出。
lines.en: Tar seeps slowly from between my scales.

lines.zh: 我的三个头朝三个方向，脚步只有一个。
lines.en: Three heads face three ways; my steps go one way.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下黑色的坑。
lines.en: Every step leaves a black pit behind.

lines.zh: 我贴着山脊走，云在下面。
lines.en: I walk the ridge with the clouds below me.

lines.zh: 路过麦田时，麦子全焦了。
lines.en: Crossing the wheat field, the wheat chars.

lines.zh: 我拖着长长的尾巴，把路犁开。
lines.en: I drag my long tail and plow the road open.

lines.zh: 电击头在走路时冒着细小的火花。
lines.en: The shock head spits tiny sparks as I walk.

lines.zh: 声波头低低地嗡着，像在哼。
lines.en: The sonic head hums low, almost like singing.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为我不必赶路。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because I need not hurry.

lines.zh: 落下的焦油在身后积成池。
lines.en: The tar I shed pools behind me.

lines.zh: 我伏在地上，三颗头轮流警戒。
lines.en: I lie low while three heads keep watch in turn.

lines.zh: 焦油从我下巴滴到石头上。
lines.en: Tar drips from my jaw onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带着硫味和腐味。
lines.en: My breath carries sulfur and rot.

lines.zh: 电击头打了个小火花，把自己吓了一跳。
lines.en: The shock head sparks and startles itself.

lines.zh: 声波头朝天空发出一次低鸣。
lines.en: The sonic head sends one low call into the sky.

lines.zh: 我在想上一次飞是什么时候。
lines.en: I am thinking about the last time I flew.

lines.zh: 三颗头难得同时安静。
lines.en: Rarely do all three heads fall quiet together.

lines.zh: 焦油池映出我歪斜的影子。
lines.en: The tar pool mirrors my crooked shadow.

lines.zh: 一只乌鸦落在我背上，又陷进去。
lines.en: A crow lands on my back and sinks in.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片一片一片地剥落。
lines.en: My scales flake off one by one.

lines.zh: 远处雷声滚过，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: Thunder rolls far off and one head lifts.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，只需要伏着。
lines.en: I need no sleep, only to lie still.

lines.zh: 风把我的焦油吹出波纹。
lines.en: Wind ripples the tar coating my hide.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有几个念头。
lines.en: I cannot count how many minds I have.

lines.zh: 三颗头同时转过来，你只看见一颗。
lines.en: All three heads turn; you only notice one.

lines.zh: 焦油头先看你，另外两颗在看你身后。
lines.en: The tar head watches you, the others watch behind you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在焦油里变形了。
lines.en: Your reflection warps in the tar.

lines.zh: 我把头低到与你平齐。
lines.en: I lower one head level with yours.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在抖，我看得很清。
lines.en: I see clearly how your sword hand shakes.

lines.zh: 电击头对你眨了一下。
lines.en: The shock head blinks at you once.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我想起旧战场。
lines.en: The iron smell on you recalls an old battlefield.

lines.zh: 我歪头，焦油从嘴角拉成丝。
lines.en: I tilt my head and tar strings from my jaw.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我的尾巴绕了过去。
lines.en: You step back and my tail curls around behind.

lines.zh: 声波头在测你心跳的快慢。
lines.en: The sonic head measures how fast your heart beats.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久，久到你以为我忘了。
lines.en: I stare so long you think I forgot.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，正好对上中间那颗。
lines.en: You look up and meet the middle head.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在鳞上，只留下白痕。
lines.en: Your blade leaves a white mark on my scales.

lines.zh: 护甲十五点，你砍得手都酸了。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armor; your arms must ache.

lines.zh: 焦油从伤口涌出，把剑黏住。
lines.en: Tar pours from the wound and gums your sword.

lines.zh: 我一颗头受伤，另外两颗更凶。
lines.en: One head is hurt and the other two grow fiercer.

lines.zh: 这一下让我退到焦油池边。
lines.en: That blow drives me back to the tar pool.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，屋顶的瓦落下来。
lines.en: I roar and tiles slide off the roof.

lines.zh: 你砍中脖子，却没有砍断。
lines.en: You strike my neck but do not cut through.

lines.zh: 伤口自己在愈合，用焦油补的。
lines.en: The wound closes itself, patched with tar.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，够你砍一整晚。
lines.en: Three hundred points of life; enough for a whole night.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把疼甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my heads to throw the pain off.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，我的三颗头都不感兴趣。
lines.en: You hold up meat; none of my three heads cares.

lines.zh: 我只吃烧焦的东西，你的太新鲜。
lines.en: I eat only charred things; yours is too fresh.

lines.zh: 你把火把递近，我倒退了一步。
lines.en: You push the torch close and I recoil a step.

lines.zh: 别喂我，喂焦油池吧。
lines.en: Do not feed me; feed the tar pool.

lines.zh: 你的手里有铁，我闻得出。
lines.en: There is iron in your hand; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅你，然后打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: I sniff you, then sneeze.

lines.zh: 那点食物不够填一颗头。
lines.en: That morsel would not fill one head.

lines.zh: 你想讨好我，先学会不怕火。
lines.en: To please me, first learn not to fear fire.

lines.zh: 我把焦油吐在你脚边，算回礼。
lines.en: I spit tar at your feet as a gift in return.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我三颗头都松了口气。
lines.en: When you back off, all three heads relax.

lines.zh: 焦油从鳞缝里往外渗。
lines.en: Tar seeps out from between my scales.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过，你飞出去两格。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and you fly two blocks.

lines.zh: 焦油沾上你的靴子，你走不动了。
lines.en: Tar sticks to your boots and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧了侧身，翅膀张开了。
lines.en: The shove turns me sideways and my wings open.

lines.zh: 三颗头一起低头看你。
lines.en: All three heads look down at you together.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我的鳞割破了你的手。
lines.en: You are too close; my scales cut your hand.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我咳出一口黑烟。
lines.en: The impact makes me cough out black smoke.

lines.zh: 你从我腿间钻过去，我懒得转身。
lines.en: You slip between my legs; I cannot be bothered to turn.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上按出一个印。
lines.en: My claw presses a print into the ground.

lines.zh: 你退后时，肩上多了一道焦痕。
lines.en: When you retreat, a scorch mark is on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 龙形的灾厄不需要伴侣。
lines.en: A dragon-shaped calamity needs no partner.

lines.zh: 我的同类都是从焦油里爬出来的。
lines.en: My kind crawl out of tar, not out of bonds.

lines.zh: 三颗头意见不合，谈不了这些。
lines.en: My three heads disagree; such matters are impossible.

lines.zh: 焦油池就是我的巢，也是产房。
lines.en: The tar pool is both my nest and my nursery.

lines.zh: 你想靠近，先问问声波头。
lines.en: If you come close, ask the sonic head first.

lines.zh: 我们相遇只会互相吞掉。
lines.en: When two of us meet, one swallows the other.

lines.zh: 我不需要后代，焦油会替我生。
lines.en: I need no offspring; the tar breeds for me.

lines.zh: 你身上的热度让我有点怀念。
lines.en: The warmth of you makes me almost nostalgic.

lines.zh: 别把手放在我颈上，那里没有脉搏。
lines.en: Do not rest your hand on my neck; there is no pulse.

lines.zh: 我把头转开，这已经算拒绝。
lines.en: I turn a head away; that counts as refusal.

lines.zh: 我用爪子勾起一块铁，随手扔进焦油。
lines.en: I hook a piece of iron and drop it in the tar.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西都会被焦油吞掉。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground, the tar swallows.

lines.zh: 我叼起你的盾，咬出一个洞。
lines.en: I take your shield in my jaws and bite a hole.

lines.zh: 这堆骨头我留着垫巢。
lines.en: I keep this pile of bones to line my nest.

lines.zh: 拾东西这种事，交给尾巴。
lines.en: Picking things up is a job for the tail.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块发亮的石头，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a shining stone and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 剑我咬断了，断口很整齐。
lines.en: I bite the sword in two with a clean break.

lines.zh: 焦油池里已经沉了不少铁。
lines.en: Quite a lot of iron has sunk into my pool.

lines.zh: 我把箭一根根踩进泥里。
lines.en: I stamp the arrows into the mud one by one.

lines.zh: 那东西太小，我的爪子夹不住。
lines.en: That thing is too small for my claws to hold.

lines.zh: 三颗头同时锁定你，跑不掉了。
lines.en: All three heads lock on; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 焦油头先动，另外两颗在封路。
lines.en: The tar head moves first while the others cut your path.

lines.zh: 你站在我的落点上。
lines.en: You are standing where I intend to land.

lines.zh: 空中灾厄看见你了。
lines.en: The calamity of the sky has seen you.

lines.zh: 我从天上认出了你，很难认错。
lines.en: I picked you out from the air; hard to mistake.

lines.zh: 声波头先叫，那是给同族的信号。
lines.en: The sonic head calls first, a signal to my kind.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一刻，就已经输了。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, you had already lost.

lines.zh: 三颗头分三路，你只挡得住一路。
lines.en: Three heads take three routes; you can block one.

lines.zh: 焦油滴在你脚边，那是标记。
lines.en: Tar drips at your feet; that is the mark.

lines.zh: 我开始振翅，风先把屋顶掀了。
lines.en: I begin to beat my wings and the wind takes the roof.

lines.zh: 你退到崖边，我在上面等着。
lines.en: You back to the cliff edge; I wait above.

lines.zh: 三颗头都张了嘴，你挑一个。
lines.en: All three heads open wide; pick one.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你脚前，那是界。
lines.en: My shadow falls at your feet; that is the line.

lines.zh: 我开始低飞，风压得你抬不起头。
lines.en: I drop into low flight and the wind pins your head down.

lines.zh: 焦油头压低，瞄准你的膝盖。
lines.en: The tar head drops low and aims at your knee.

lines.zh: 电击头在积攒那一下。
lines.en: The shock head is gathering its charge.

lines.zh: 声波头张嘴，你先捂住了耳朵。
lines.en: The sonic head opens wide and you cover your ears.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，尾巴从右边来。
lines.en: I circle left while my tail comes from the right.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，我把树撞断。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I break the tree.

lines.zh: 三颗头各自算着距离。
lines.en: Each head is calculating its own distance.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住你，你才发现我多大。
lines.en: My shadow covers you before you realize my size.

lines.zh: 焦油弹已经在喉咙里了。
lines.en: The tar shot is already in my throat.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我只需要滑翔一段。
lines.en: You run; I only need one glide.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，等它乱。
lines.en: I count your breaths, waiting for them to break.

lines.zh: 焦油头算过你的落点，很准。
lines.en: The tar head has your landing spot, and it is accurate.

lines.zh: 电击头绕到左边，那条路封了。
lines.en: The shock head swings left; that road is closed.

lines.zh: 声波头贴着地传声，你听得见。
lines.en: The sonic head sends sound along the ground; you hear it.

lines.zh: 我从上往下看，你的头顶是靶心。
lines.en: From above, the top of your head is the bullseye.

lines.zh: 焦油头先吐，另外两颗头等着。
lines.en: The tar head spits first. The other two wait.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍下，地面陷了半格。
lines.en: One claw comes down and the ground sinks half a block.

lines.zh: 焦油头咬住你的肩，甩了甩。
lines.en: The tar head bites your shoulder and shakes.

lines.zh: 电击头一碰，你浑身抽搐。
lines.en: The shock head touches you and your whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 声波头一吼，你的耳朵流血了。
lines.en: The sonic head roars and your ears bleed.

lines.zh: 十点伤害，我只用了半力。
lines.en: Ten points of damage, and I used half my strength.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫断你身后的柱子。
lines.en: My tail snaps the pillar behind you.

lines.zh: 我把你按在焦油里。
lines.en: I press you down into the tar.

lines.zh: 你想滚开，我的爪子跟着。
lines.en: You try to roll away; my claw follows.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空，焦油溅了你一脸。
lines.en: The bite misses and tar splashes your face.

lines.zh: 别站起来，三颗头都还张着嘴。
lines.en: Do not get up; all three heads are still open.

lines.zh: 我一头撞下来，整面屋墙塌了。
lines.en: I slam down head first and a whole wall collapses.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住你的脚，往焦油里拖。
lines.en: My claws catch your foot and drag you toward the tar.

lines.zh: 三个头轮流咬，你挡不过来。
lines.en: Three heads bite in turn; you cannot block them all.

lines.zh: 我甩尾的时候，你被扫到了墙上。
lines.en: When I swing my tail, you are swept into the wall.

lines.zh: 焦油池翻涌，我从中抬起头。
lines.en: The tar pool churns and I raise my head out of it.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，从头一颗颗接上。
lines.en: Three hundred points of life, head by head.

lines.zh: 我先长出翅膀，再长出第三颗头。
lines.en: Wings first, then the third head.

lines.zh: 村里的人抬头时，天已经黑了。
lines.en: When the village looks up, the sky is already dark.

lines.zh: 焦油顺着我的脊背往下淌。
lines.en: Tar runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 我的第一声是三颗头一起叫的。
lines.en: My first sound is three heads crying at once.

lines.zh: 我落在钟楼上，钟塌了。
lines.en: I land on the bell tower and the tower gives way.

lines.zh: 闪电头在出生时就把云引来了。
lines.en: The shock head drew the clouds at birth.

lines.zh: 我的尸体焦油还热着。
lines.en: The tar of my corpse is still warm.

lines.zh: 我从天边来，带着一片黑。
lines.en: I come from the horizon with a patch of black.

lines.zh: 落地那一下，周围的鸟全飞了。
lines.en: At my landing, every bird takes flight.

lines.zh: 没人教我飞，我张开翅膀就会。
lines.en: No one taught me to fly; I opened my wings and knew.

lines.zh: 焦油先冒泡，然后才长出翅膀。
lines.en: The tar bubbles first; the wings come later.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里钻出来，天开始下雨。
lines.en: I climb out of the fissure and the rain begins.

lines.zh: 焦油池边上起了泡，我先探头。
lines.en: The tar pool bubbles, and I lift a head out.

lines.zh: 三颗头一起睁眼，云就压低了。
lines.en: All three heads open, and the clouds sink.

lines.zh: 火算什么东西，我身上全是焦油。
lines.en: What is fire to me? I am made of tar.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，砸出一个焦油坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and crater the ground with tar.

lines.zh: 水浇在我背上，冒出大片白汽。
lines.en: Water hits my back and a sheet of steam rises.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕掉我半片翅膀，我照样站着。
lines.en: The blast tears half a wing off; I still stand.

lines.zh: 箭扎在鳞缝里，像一根细刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in a scale seam like a splinter.

lines.zh: 魔法的光在我体内乱窜，三颗头都疼。
lines.en: Magic races inside me and all three heads ache.

lines.zh: 我吃焦土，慢慢饿这种事轮不到我。
lines.en: I eat scorched earth; slow hunger is not my fate.

lines.zh: 雷劈中电击头，它高兴得直叫。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shock head, which shrieks with joy.

lines.zh: 虚空扯着我的翅膀，我仍朝上挣。
lines.en: The void pulls my wings, and I still strain upward.
